## trade-valuation: Trade valuation (from CSV)

### 14.1 What it is and who reads it

Each trade's valuation of the day from the risk engine: its netting set, counterparty, book, status, notional and MtM.

A trade's valuation from the risk engine, for every source system: MTM, one-day P&L and DV01, with what it values (source system, portfolio, desk, product).

- **Contract:** `modules/banking/packs/market-risk/contracts/trade-valuation.contract.yaml` (pack `market-risk`, class `fundamental`), key `VALUATION_ID`.
- **Mapping:** `tools/loaders/mrloader/kinds/trade-valuation.yaml` (source `canonical`); wave 2 of the CSV loaders.
- **Grain:** One row per trade valuation per business date, keyed by VALUATION_ID.

### 14.2 The command

```bash
python3 tools/loaders/mrloader/csv_load.py --kind trade-valuation --csv FILE --date YYYY-MM-DD --dry-run   # check; write nothing
python3 tools/loaders/mrloader/csv_load.py --kind trade-valuation --csv FILE --date YYYY-MM-DD --inbox     # convert and hand to the data inbox
python3 tools/loaders/mrloader/csv_load.py --kind trade-valuation --template                                       # the header and an example row
```

In a day file: `trade-valuation: {csv: "FILE"}`. A bank's own column names: a mapping file of its own, given with `--mapping FILE`.

### 14.3 The CSV, column by column

The file's format: delimiter `,`, encoding `utf-8`, decimal `.`, thousands `,`, dates `YYYY-MM-DD` (declared in the mapping's `csv:` block over `kinds/shared/csv.yaml`; never guessed). Column names compare upper-cased, other characters as `_`.

| Column | Required | Field | Rule | Description | Decision |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `TRADE_ID` | yes | `TRADE_ID` | text, kept as written | The trade valued: a TRADE_ID of the trading pack's trade kind, as text (ENDUR digits, CLY-…, MX-…). | as the source system writes it: text |
| `VALUATION_ID` | no | `VALUATION_ID` | empty: `TVAL-{@TRADE_ID}`; text, kept as written | The record's id (the business key) |  |
| `SOURCE_SYSTEM` | yes | `SOURCE_SYSTEM` | upper-cased | The trade's booking system: ENDUR, CALYPSO or MUREX. |  |
| `PRODUCT_TYPE` | yes | `PRODUCT_TYPE` | as written | The trade's product type as booked (ComSwap, IRS_FIXFLOAT …), the trade's PRODUCT_TYPE. |  |
| `PRODUCT_GROUP` | yes | `PRODUCT_GROUP` | as written | The trade's product group (Commodity, Rates, FX, Credit, Equity …). |  |
| `PORTFOLIO` | yes | `PORTFOLIO` | upper-cased, other characters `-`; prefixed `BOOK-` unless it has it; text, kept as written | The book the trade sits in: a BOOK_ID of the core pack's book kind (BOOK-…). |  |
| `DESK` | yes | `DESK` | upper-cased, other characters `-`; prefixed `DESK-` unless it has it; text, kept as written | The desk of the trade's book: a DESK_ID of the core pack's desk kind (DESK-…). |  |
| `COUNTERPARTY` | yes | `COUNTERPARTY` | upper-cased, other characters `-`; prefixed `CP-` unless it has it; text, kept as written | The trade's counterparty: a COUNTERPARTY_ID of the core pack's counterparty kind (CP-…). |  |
| `NETTING_SET` | no | `NETTING_SET` | upper-cased, other characters `-`; prefixed `NS-` unless it has it; text, kept as written | The netting set the trade belongs to: a NETTING_SET_ID of the counterparty-risk pack's netting-set kind (NS-<counterparty>-<legal entity>). | empty: outside every set (stand-alone) |
| `TRADER_ID` | no | `TRADER_ID` | upper-cased, other characters `-`; prefixed `TRDR-` unless it has it; text, kept as written | The trader of the trade: a TRADER_ID of the core pack's trader kind (TRDR-…). The VaR engine's VaR by trader joins it to the P&L vectors by TRADE_ID (contributions by=attribute:TRADER_ID), so it is kept as a column of th |  |
| `BUY_SELL_CODE` | yes | `BUY_SELL_CODE` | upper-cased; mapped: `B` to `B`, `S` to `S`, `BUY` to `B`, `SELL` to `S` | B when the bank bought (or receives), S when it sold. |  |
| `TRADE_STATUS` | yes | `TRADE_STATUS` | upper-cased | The trade's status on the valuation date: NEW, VALIDATED, AMENDED, MATURED or CANCELLED; a trade that ends keeps a row on that date with its last value. | NEW, VALIDATED, AMENDED, CANCELLED, MATURED |
| `CURRENCY` | yes | `CURRENCY` | upper-cased | The trade's own currency, ISO 4217 (MTM is in USD whatever it is). |  |
| `NOTIONAL` | yes | `NOTIONAL` | a number (decimal `.`) | The trade's current notional in USD, absolute (the first leg's). |  |
| `MTM` | yes | `MTM` | a number (decimal `.`) | The trade's mark-to-market on the valuation date in USD, dirty (accrued included); positive is an asset of the bank. | signed: positive when the counterparty owes the bank |
| `MTM_CURRENCY` | no | `MTM_CURRENCY` | upper-cased; empty: `USD` | The currency MTM, PNL_1D and DV01 are reported in (USD in the demo). |  |
| `PNL_1D` | no | `PNL_1D` | a number (decimal `.`) | The valuation engine's own one-day P&L of the trade in USD, gain positive. |  |
| `DV01` | no | `DV01` | a number (decimal `.`) | The change of MTM in USD for a +1 bp parallel shift of every rate curve (a receiver swap's is positive); 0 when the trade has no rate risk. |  |
| `TRADE_DATE` | yes | `TRADE_DATE` | a date (YYYY-MM-DD, or YYYYMMDD) | The date the trade was dealt (YYYY-MM-DD). |  |
| `MATURITY_DATE` | yes | `MATURITY_DATE` | a date (YYYY-MM-DD, or YYYYMMDD) | The trade's maturity date. |  |
| `VALUATION_DATE` | no | `VALUATION_DATE` | empty: `{$business_date}`; a date (YYYY-MM-DD, or YYYYMMDD) | The date the trade is valued on: the business date of the file. |  |

## desk-pnl: Desk P&L: actual and hypothetical (daily) (from CSV)

### 15.1 What it is and who reads it

Each desk's actual (clean) and hypothetical P&L of the day, in USD, for the VaR backtest: one row per desk and legal entity.

The bank's daily P&L of each desk for regulatory backtesting (VAR_GUIDE.md section 15.16): the actual P&L from finance (clean: fees, commissions, reserves, net interest income and intraday trading left out) and the hypothetical P&L from front office (yesterday's positions revalued on today's market), in USD. Never an input of the VaR engine: the backtest compares the official VaR of the day before with them. Drishti's own risk-theoretical P&L (the official record's hypoPnl) is not this kind.

- **Contract:** `modules/banking/packs/market-risk/contracts/desk-pnl.contract.yaml` (pack `market-risk`, class `input`), key `DESK_PNL_ID`.
- **Mapping:** `tools/loaders/mrloader/kinds/desk-pnl.yaml` (source `canonical`); wave 1 of the CSV loaders.
- **Grain:** One row per desk (and its legal entity) per BUSINESS_DATE, keyed by DESK_PNL_ID (DPNL-<DESK_ID>-<BUSINESS_DATE>).

### 15.2 The command

```bash
python3 tools/loaders/mrloader/csv_load.py --kind desk-pnl --csv FILE --date YYYY-MM-DD --dry-run   # check; write nothing
python3 tools/loaders/mrloader/csv_load.py --kind desk-pnl --csv FILE --date YYYY-MM-DD --inbox     # convert and hand to the data inbox
python3 tools/loaders/mrloader/csv_load.py --kind desk-pnl --template                                       # the header and an example row
```

In a day file: `desk-pnl: {csv: "FILE"}`. A bank's own column names: a mapping file of its own, given with `--mapping FILE`.

### 15.3 The CSV, column by column

The file's format: delimiter `,`, encoding `utf-8`, decimal `.`, thousands `,`, dates `YYYY-MM-DD` (declared in the mapping's `csv:` block over `kinds/shared/csv.yaml`; never guessed). Column names compare upper-cased, other characters as `_`.

| Column | Required | Field | Rule | Description | Decision |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `DESK_ID` | yes | `DESK_ID` | upper-cased, other characters `-`; prefixed `DESK-` unless it has it; text, kept as written | The desk: the id of a desk node of the hierarchies (DESK-RATES is the node MGMT~DESK-RATES). A node's P&L is the sum of its desks' rows; the bank's, of every row. |  |
| `LEGAL_ENTITY` | no | `LEGAL_ENTITY` | upper-cased, other characters `-`; prefixed `LE-` unless it has it; text, kept as written | The legal entity the desk's P&L is booked in: the LEGAL hierarchy's nodes sum the rows of their entity. |  |
| (none) | no | `DESK_PNL_ID` | built: `DPNL-{@DESK_ID}-{$business_date}`; text, kept as written | The record's id, DPNL-<DESK_ID>-<BUSINESS_DATE> (the business key) |  |
| (none) | no | `BUSINESS_DATE` | built: `{$business_date}`; a date (YYYY-MM-DD, or YYYYMMDD) | The business date the P&L is of (YYYY-MM-DD): the day the market moved, tested against the official VaR of the business day before. |  |
| `ACTUAL_PNL` | yes | `ACTUAL_PNL` | a number (decimal `.`) | Finance's clean actual P&L of the day: fees, commissions, reserves, net interest income and intraday trading left out (US 12 CFR 217.204(b); OSFI CAR chapter 9). Negative is a loss. | signed: a loss is negative; never zero for a missing value |
| `HYPOTHETICAL_PNL` | yes | `HYPOTHETICAL_PNL` | a number (decimal `.`) | Front office's hypothetical P&L of the day: the end of the day before's positions revalued on the day's market, nothing traded. Negative is a loss. |  |
| `FEES_AND_COMMISSIONS` | no | `FEES_AND_COMMISSIONS` | a number (decimal `.`) | What finance left out of ACTUAL_PNL (fees, commissions, reserves), for the record: never part of a backtest. |  |
| `CURRENCY` | no | `CURRENCY` | upper-cased; empty: `USD` | The currency of the amounts, ISO 4217: USD. |  |
| `SOURCE` | yes | `SOURCE` | as written | The system the row came from (the finance ledger or the front-office P&L system); demo-finance on the test data. |  |
| `AS_OF` | no | `AS_OF` | empty: `{$computed_at}`; ISO-8601 with a zone | When the source produced the figures (UTC). A restated day is sent again with a later AS_OF; the lake's newest row wins. |  |

### 15.4 A sample

The first rows of `tools/loaders/mrloader/samples/desk-pnl.csv` (synthetic):

```csv
DESK_ID,LEGAL_ENTITY,ACTUAL_PNL,HYPOTHETICAL_PNL,FEES_AND_COMMISSIONS,CURRENCY,SOURCE,AS_OF
RATES TRADING-LON,GMO_SPOG,-824000,-724000,222000,USD,synthetic-finance,2026-11-18T22:00:00Z
FX OPTIONS-ZRH,GMO_SPOG,-44000,-757000,123000,USD,synthetic-finance,2026-11-18T22:00:00Z
```

The first record of `tools/loaders/mrloader/samples/desk-pnl.expected.jsonl` (records are written in key order):

```json
{"DESK_ID":"DESK-CREDIT-FLOW-HKG","LEGAL_ENTITY":"LE-MARKETS-INC","DESK_PNL_ID":"DPNL-DESK-CREDIT-FLOW-HKG-2026-11-18","BUSINESS_DATE":"2026-11-18","ACTUAL_PNL":-647000.0,"HYPOTHETICAL_PNL":-443000.0,"FEES_AND_COMMISSIONS":298000.0,"CURRENCY":"USD","SOURCE":"synthetic-finance","AS_OF":"2026-11-18T22:00:00Z"}
```

### 15.5 What is not loaded

Nothing: every field the CSV gives is loaded.

### 15.6 Checks

- **A rejected row:** `on-reject: refuse` (any rejected row refuses the whole kind: fix the file and run again). A duplicate key always refuses it.
- **Unique:** `DESK_PNL_ID` per business date.
- **Link** `LEGAL_ENTITY` to `legal-entity`: policy `warn` (mr_run.py checks it against the day's `legal-entity` file, else `--against`; a target found nowhere is *not checked*).
- **Link** `DESK_ID` to `desk`: policy `warn` (mr_run.py checks it against the day's `desk` file, else `--against`; a target found nowhere is *not checked*).

Reject codes it can give: `MISSING_REQUIRED`, `BAD_DATE`, `BAD_NUMBER`, `BAD_TIMESTAMP`, `EXCEL_NUMBER_ID`, `BAD_ENUM`, `BAD_PATTERN`, `DUPLICATE_KEY`, `EXCEL_ERROR`, `FORMULA`, `BAD_ROW_SHAPE`.
Each line of `<kind>.<date>.rejects.csv` gives FILE, ROW (as a spreadsheet shows it), KEY, COLUMN, FIELD, VALUE, REASON, WHY, FIX.

### 15.7 Before and after

- **Load first:** `desk`.
- **Then:** nothing depends on it.

### 15.8 Repeat, restate, remove

- **Again for the same date:** the same command; the date's `desk-pnl` rows are replaced as a whole (`mode: replace`).
- **Restate a past date:** run with that `--date`; to change one row, send the whole file again.
- **Remove the date:** `python3 tools/drishti.py lake delete --lake LAKE --kind desk-pnl --date YYYY-MM-DD --dry-run` (then without `--dry-run`).

### 15.9 Spreadsheet warnings

- `DESK_ID`: an id: export the column as text (a long id saved as a number, `2.00001E+11`, is refused; leading zeros lost are not detectable without `pad:`)
- `LEGAL_ENTITY`: an id: export the column as text (a long id saved as a number, `2.00001E+11`, is refused; leading zeros lost are not detectable without `pad:`)

### 15.10 Source variants

None shipped. A source with other column names gets a mapping file `kinds/desk-pnl.<source>.yaml` (or a site's own, by `--mapping`).
